name: Chosen Uar Warriors

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: Improves a unit's attack capabilities for an extended period of time.

abilities.name: Rapid Advance
abilities.text: Improved unit movement speed over an extended period.

attributes.name: Disciplined
attributes.text: This unit does not suffer a morale penalty when the general dies. It can also rally after routing more often.

attributes.name: Hide (forest)
attributes.text: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.

attributes.name: Scare (everyone)
attributes.text: This unit frightens all enemy units.

attributes.name: Immune to Fear
attributes.text: This unit is immune to the fear effects of scary units.

short: Only the bravest are chosen to be the champions of their tribes.
history: The Uars, also known as the ‘White Huns,’ are thought to be part of the Hephthalites, a nomadic people. Their origins are still debated by historians, some arguing that they were of Iranian decent, while others suggesting that they were Turkic. Unlike the ‘Black Huns’ of the north, the Uars had fair complexions and their aristocracy bedecked themselves in fine clothes and jewellery. Their main stronghold, Tokharistan, was situated on the northern slopes of the Hindu Kush Mountains. By the 5th century AD the Uars had succeeded in expanding their territory as far south as India, although that situation was to be short lived. During the early 6th century AD, they were driven out by the Indian kings Yasodharman and Narasimhagupta.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
